1.why: Clear sans-serif font is used throughout with adequate line spacing.

2.why: Text avoids dense blocks, though some headers use full capitalization.

3.why: Layout is well organized within a narrow card appropriate for mobile viewports.

4.why: Text instructions across all steps are short and direct.

5.why: Form fields do not provide visible placeholder examples of input formats.

6.why: Content remains concise with no long reading required to progress.

7.why: Manual setup keys and recovery codes lack dedicated copy buttons.

8.why: Setup screen provides a manual secret string without displaying a QR code option.

9.why: Standard form inputs appear compatible with typical browser password tools.

10.why: Bold headers and highlighted primary buttons visually emphasize current actions.

11.why: Most screens focus on a single action, though setup displays multiple buttons.

12.why: Page headings update to reflect state, though explicit status text is brief.

13.why: Interface allows regenerating codes and re-attempting steps freely.

14.why: Error banner uses neutral phrasing but provides minimal detail on resolution.

15.why: Screens display no visible countdown timers or operational time limits.
